name: 2D-Alloy Database
description: DFT structures and formation thermodynamics for transition-metal dichalcogenide alloy monolayers.

sources.title: 2DHub: 2D-Alloy Database
sources.evidence: Provider specifies 400 1T/2H TMDC alloys, atomic structures, PBE thermodynamics and downloadable ASE database.

caveats: A computational alloy cohort, not 400 experimentally synthesized monolayers.
Free download availability does not establish a verified redistribution licence.

name: Experimental 2D Materials Database (X2DB)
description: Structured literature metadata for experimentally realized monolayer and few-layer materials, linked where possible to computational structures.
count_scope: Live unfiltered X2DB rows; multiple publications or samples may share composition

sources.title: X2DB live provider table
sources.evidence: Unfiltered table displays 603 rows and CC BY-NC 4.0 licensing.

sources.title: 2DHub: X2DB documentation
sources.evidence: Provider describes experimental literature metadata and computational structure links; explicitly excludes measurement datasets.

caveats: Contains metadata, not raw experimental measurement datasets.
603 rows are not necessarily 603 unique compositions or atomic structures.
Noncommercial licence conditions apply.

name: Quantum-Chemical Bonding Database for Solid-State Materials (2023)
description: LOBSTER bonding descriptors and computational outputs for insulating and semiconducting solids linked to Materials Project IDs.
count_scope: Original 2023 release; two archive parts cover one 1520-compound cohort

sources.title: LOBSTER database Part 1 author deposit
sources.evidence: Describes all 1520 compounds in lightweight JSON, larger outputs for 700, CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: LOBSTER database Part 2 author deposit
sources.evidence: Provides remaining 820 large-output records; same cohort and CC BY 4.0.

caveats: Parts 1 and 2 overlap through the common lightweight cohort; do not sum them as separate materials.
The collection also links a newer 2026 NOMAD DOI with a claimed larger scope; its count was not independently verified and is not substituted here.
Structures are linked to source IDs; this is chiefly a bonding-property dataset.

name: Carbon-data synthetic atomistic trajectories
description: Carbon melt–quench–anneal trajectories spanning crystalline, graphitic and amorphous environments, labeled by C-GAP-17.
count_scope: Arithmetic from provider trajectory and per-trajectory snapshot counts; raw trajectory files not independently enumerated

sources.title: Carbon-data author README
sources.evidence: Specifies 546 trajectories, 210 snapshots each and 200 atoms per snapshot; labels come from C-GAP-17.

caveats: The 22.9-million headline counts atomic environments, not structures or materials.
Energies and forces are generated by a fitted potential, not newly calculated DFT reference labels.
Includes amorphous and molecular-like carbon environments alongside crystalline phases.
Data licence was not verified.

additional_counts.scope: 546 × 210 snapshots × 200 atoms; headline rounded to 22.9 million

name: ZeoSyn zeolite synthesis dataset
description: Literature-curated zeolite hydrothermal routes linking gel composition, crystallization conditions, organic templates and framework products.
count_scope: Author repository cohort covering 233 zeolite topologies and 921 organic structure-directing agents
license: MIT (repository-wide declaration; data-specific licence not separately verified)

sources.title: ZeoSyn author README
sources.evidence: Reports 23961 routes, 233 topologies and 921 OSDAs; identifies source workbook and synthesis fields.

sources.title: ZeoSyn repository licence
sources.evidence: Repository declares MIT; no separate dataset-specific licence was located in this bounded audit.

caveats: Synthesis routes are not distinct atomic structures or materials.
Framework codes link products to structural classes; routes do not guarantee unique refined coordinates.
The collection labels data CC BY; this audit preserves the directly observed repository declaration and the licence uncertainty.

name: Material Synthesis 2025 (MatSyn25)
description: Automatically extracted two-dimensional-material synthesis procedures with material and process information.
version: 2025-10-01 author preprint and public data card
count_scope: Author-described extraction from 85160 articles; not a count of unique materials

sources.title: MatSyn25 author preprint
sources.evidence: Abstract reports 163240 synthesis processes extracted from 85160 articles.

caveats: LLM/text extraction is not independent experimental reproduction.
Process entries are not distinct crystal structures.
Noncommercial licence applies; payload completeness was not audited.

name: AQCat25 heterogeneous-catalysis dataset
description: Spin-aware higher-fidelity DFT catalyst–intermediate data distributed as queryable metadata and ASE archives.
count_scope: Provider headline wording; approximately 5000 materials and 47000 intermediate–catalyst systems, not 13.5 million unique materials

sources.title: AQCat25 provider data card
sources.evidence: Reports 13.5 million DFT calculation trajectories, about 5K materials and 47K catalyst systems; metadata uses frame_id; file access requires accepting conditions.

caveats: Provider headline uses trajectories while metadata is frame-indexed; exact trajectory/frame distinction was not independently reconciled.
Accepting access conditions is required; raw file retrieval without acceptance returned 401.
Noncommercial/share-alike licence; commercial arrangements are separate.
Adsorbate–slab configurations are not bulk-crystal discovery results.

name: Open Catalyst Experiments 2024 (OCx24) experimental data
description: Electrocatalyst tests with composition, XRF and XRD phase-matching metadata, linked to a separate computational screening cohort.
count_display: 5,412 raw test rows; 672 distinct sample IDs
count_scope: Directly counted in pinned raw CSV; repeated conditions/reactions/replicates per sample

sources.title: OCx24 pinned raw experimental CSV
sources.evidence: Direct CSV enumeration gives 5412 rows and 672 unique sample id values; SHA-256 saved in receipt.

sources.title: OCx24 author data documentation
sources.evidence: Defines experimental/XRD/XRF data and separate clean/processed cohorts; computational screening is a separate table.

caveats: Raw sample-ID count differs from the collection's 572-sample summary; retain exact cohort and filtering definitions.
Replicates and test conditions expand row count; rows are not unique compositions.
XRD phase matches do not establish unique atomic structures for every sample.
MIT software licence was observed; separate experimental-data reuse licence was not verified.

additional_counts.scope: Pinned raw experimental CSV, including all unfiltered samples
